title: Render QC: loudness, dead frames, empty first frame
what_it_does: qc.py checks a render against YouTube loudness (-14 LUFS, -1 dBTP), finds stretches over 3 s where nothing on screen changes, black gaps, and an empty first frame (the cover on Shorts and Reels), plus per-scene pacing in words per minute.
when_to_use: Before delivering any video; the first-frame and dead-picture checks are the ones people forget.
why: The file is 1072 lines tied to Remotion project configs; only the --render checks are portable, so reimplement those against a HyperFrames output instead of copying.
